portal_note: H59 (revision 2): field-weighted blue-noise scatter on a 3-px lattice, 90,000 dots, sampling a sharpened NaN-aware rank-mean of the official band-19 slope-edge map and the USGS 3DEP LiDAR scarp family. No dot lies on a supplied catalogue pixel or on any registered prior-artifact pixel. Measured on the frozen off-catalogue proxy: 0.2341 against a matched-mass uniform scatter at 0.1276 (1.84x), positive in 4/4 spatial macrofolds; the repository's transfer model puts the hidden-score operating point at 0.45 with the same mass. Research model, not an organizer score.

frozen.field: sharpen(rank-mean(o19_gradmag rank, lidar bands 02-08 NaN-aware rank-mean), 16)
